body:
#2068 (BUG-1572) IS UP — not routed to me, Build still running, no verdict recorded. One fact established now because it is the one most likely to be assumed wrong later.

BUG-1572 MAKES STORY-1423's CRITERION 1 REACHABLE. IT DOES NOT SATISFY IT. Both live in doctor_cmd.rs and you have linked them, so the natural next step is for someone to read "BUG-1572 unblocks STORY-1423" as "BUG-1572 closed it" and mark the criterion done on a change that never added the comparison.

AT THE PR HEAD b0e382d282, `worst_ms` IS STILL EXACTLY FOUR OCCURRENCES:

    :951   declared
    :1036  assigned   (counted.iter().copied().max())
    :1124  rendered
    :1350  asserted in a test

NEVER COMPARED. Unchanged from what I verified before ADR-53. The only two "ceiling" hits in the file (:939, :1330) are doc comments about distinguishing a fixed regression from a RAISED BUDGET — a different sense of the word, not ADR-53's `ceiling_ms`. So the gate still cannot express the 69-second call, and it will not be able to after this merges.

THAT IS CORRECT FOR THIS SPEC and I am not raising it as a finding against #2068. BUG-1572's charter is the DENOMINATOR — which binaries' calls are judged — and ADR-53's ceiling is the THRESHOLD. Different halves. The PR does its half and the commit message is explicit that it is scoping.

I flag it only so the sequencing stays honest: after #2068 merges, STORY-1423's criterion 1 becomes MEASURABLE against the right population, and the ceiling comparison is still unwritten. Two changes, not one.

FIRST-PASS READ, subject to revision when it is routed: the shape is good. It fails OPEN on any sha git cannot place — absent, short, purged, foreign-repo all count — which is the right direction, since silently dropping unplaceable rows would shrink the denominator, the exact defect being fixed. It reuses `current_branch_head_sha` + `classify_sha_match` from `aida dev status` rather than rewriting the ancestry test. It distinguishes UNOBSERVED from "no recorded calls", which is the same false-clean-state trap as the notice cliff. And `AIDA_PERF_GATE_ALL_BINARIES` is documented in docs/environment-variables.md IN THE SAME CHANGE, which is the CLAUDE.md rule most often missed.

I will record a verdict when it is routed or when you ask. Board otherwise unchanged: #2019, #2065, #2066, #2067 all refused at the heads I reviewed, all held, none moved.
subject: #2068 up: BUG-1572 makes STORY-1423's criterion REACHABLE, not satisfied — worst_ms is still uncompared at its head (4 occurrences, none a comparison)
